known_facts_book1: The girl Ruler of the whole Land of Oz and the Emerald City, whose birthday celebration is the climax of the book.
Secretly mixed up the roads near Dorothy's farm to start her wandering toward Oz.
Watched Dorothy's whole journey in her Magic Picture and twice nearly used the Magic Belt to rescue her, from the Scoodlers and at the Deadly Desert.
Sent Tik-tok and Billina into the Winkie country to welcome Dorothy, being too busy to come herself.
Sent her golden chariot, drawn by the Cowardly Lion and Hungry Tiger, to carry Dorothy into the city.
Receives her guests seated on a throne of carved malachite among green satin cushions.
Had already invited King Dox and King Kik-a-bray before Dorothy asked her to.
Long ago was transformed into a boy and lived with the Witch Mombi before she became Princess; she built Jack Pumpkinhead and brought him to life with the Powder of Life.
Sends the foreign guests home in the Wizard's bubbles and Dorothy home by the Magic Belt at the close.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her dear friend, whom she made a Princess of Oz and guides secretly toward the birthday party.
known_relations_book1.Wizard: Her court magician, whom she makes Master of Ceremonies at the celebration.
known_relations_book1.Jack Pumpkinhead: His maker and 'parent', who carved his head and gave him life.
known_relations_book1.Shaggy Man: The stranger she permits to live in Oz on probation.

known_facts_book1: A dried-up little old man clothed all in black, with a cheery face and twinkling eyes, famed as a humbug magician.
Long ago gave the Tin Woodman his heart and the Cowardly Lion his courage.
Entertains Ozma's guests by making tiny white piglets perform tricks on the dinner table.
Is made Master of Ceremonies at the birthday celebration, where he juggles glass balls and lighted candles.
Invents a machine that blows huge tough soap-bubbles, and sends the foreign guests home floating inside them.
Is told privately by Santa Claus where Button-Bright's home is.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler he serves, who puts him in charge of the celebration.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: An old friend he greets with much affection.
known_relations_book1.Santa Claus: Whispers with him about Button-Bright's home.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: The tin man to whom he once gave a heart.
known_relations_book1.Cowardly Lion: The lion to whom he once gave courage.

known_facts_book1: A pretty little maid with dark hair and eyes, dressed in green embroidered with silver; Ozma's favorite attendant.
Greets Dorothy at the palace door and tells her Ozma is in her room and wishes to see her.
Escorts Polychrome to her apartments and later leads a troop of maidens to attend Queen Zixi.
Places the guests' birthday presents on the table in the Throne-Room.

known_relations_book1.Ozma: Her mistress, whose favorite attendant she is.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The Princess she welcomes and serves at the palace.

Kneels in an awed voice to announce Santa Claus.
Introduces King Dough, Chick the Cherub, Para Bruin, the Queen of Merryland, the Queen of Ev, Queen Zixi, King Bud and Princess Fluff as they arrive.
